title: Typical datasets hold half as many raw runs as in 2013–16, yet the number with ≥100 runs rose from 58 in 2013 to 531 in 2025
sub:
PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025 with ≥1 identified raw run or raw bundle (n = 35,141 of 36,249). Runs = vendor raw acquisitions, a lower bound when
runs are bundled; not samples (TMT puts up to 18 samples in one run). Ridges: distribution per release year (equal area, log axis); white tick = median.
Pooled medians 30 (2013–16, n = 2,498) and 16 (2023–25, n = 15,248); intervals are 95% group bootstraps over hashed PI groups.
notes: ¹ Thermo, no DIA/TMT, human, publication-linked. ² Fraction-numbered runs counted once (sample proxy). ³ Bruker 2013–16 n = 56. Grey: CI of the ratio includes 1.
